{
  "name": "agent-avatars",
  "version": "0.17.0",
  "description": "A pixel-art crew for Claude Code: distinct personalities and worlds with their own pastimes, gatherings and real-event reactions. Choose cozy, chaotic or adventure behavior and how lively the scene feels.",
  "author": {
    "name": "vanyastaff"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/vanyastaff/agent-avatars",
  "repository": "https://github.com/vanyastaff/agent-avatars",
  "license": "MIT",
  "userConfig": {
    "behavior": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Behavior",
      "description": "Cozy: gentle workshop habits. Chaotic: oversized tools and theatrical mishaps. Adventure: maps, lanterns and expedition gear. Changes the performance, never agent decisions.",
      "default": "cozy",
      "options": [
        "cozy",
        "chaotic",
        "adventure"
      ]
    },
    "liveliness": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Liveliness",
      "description": "Quiet: subtle movement and rare antics. Normal: occasional personality moments. Lively: expressive movement and more frequent antics. Independent of behavior.",
      "default": "normal",
      "options": [
        "quiet",
        "normal",
        "lively"
      ]
    },
    "skin": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Character",
      "description": "Which character the agents are. Mixed gives every agent a different one.",
      "default": "robot",
      "options": [
        "robot",
        "cat",
        "dragon",
        "anime",
        "mixed"
      ]
    },
    "scene": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Scene",
      "description": "The world the characters live in. Auto follows the character.",
      "default": "workshop",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "workshop",
        "meadow",
        "home",
        "lava",
        "sakura",
        "snow",
        "night",
        "desert",
        "space",
        "office",
        "beach",
        "city",
        "ocean",
        "halloween"
      ]
    },
    "sky": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Background",
      "description": "Transparent shows only the scenery; filled paints a sky behind it.",
      "default": "transparent",
      "options": [
        "transparent",
        "filled"
      ]
    },
    "names": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Agent names",
      "description": "static: the task text as is. short: trimmed to the point, free. ai: a small model coins a name (one small request per agent, uses your quota).",
      "default": "static",
      "options": [
        "static",
        "short",
        "ai"
      ]
    },
    "thoughts": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Speech bubbles",
      "description": "static: reading/searching/running. action: what the agent just did (read file.rs, $ cargo test), free. ai: a small model sums up the last actions (a small request every ~12 s per working agent, uses your quota).",
      "default": "static",
      "options": [
        "static",
        "action",
        "ai"
      ]
    },
    "looks": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Agents choose their looks",
      "description": "fixed: looks follow Character and personality. ai: a small model dresses each new subagent for its task (one small request per agent, uses your quota), and every agent is told it has an avatar tool to change its look, say a short line, hug or high-five another agent, dance or throw a party. Their looks are remembered.",
      "default": "fixed",
      "options": [
        "fixed",
        "ai"
      ]
    },
    "sound": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Sounds",
      "description": "Short 8-bit blips when an agent appears, finishes, fails or asks you a question. Off by default. The engine plays them with afplay, so this works on macOS only.",
      "default": "off",
      "options": [
        "off",
        "on"
      ]
    },
    "events": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "GitHub events",
      "description": "Fireworks and confetti when the session receives a pull request merge from GitHub, and sad robots when CI fails. Only the kind and outcome of the event are read.",
      "default": "on",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "look": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Light or dark",
      "description": "auto follows your Claude Code theme (and the system, if the theme says auto); dark and light force the colours of clouds, stars and snow.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "dark",
        "light"
      ]
    }
  }
}
